social_circle.name: Sarah Gatlin

demographics.occupation: Registered Nurse at a family-medicine clinic in Rockwall, TX

background.how_they_met: Biological mother; gave birth to Thomas at the hospital in Greenville, TX on August 14, 2016. Has been his primary attachment figure his entire life.
background.why_close: Sarah is Thomas's primary co-regulator and decision-coach. She uses Socratic questioning rather than directives, walked him through choosing art club over the soccer clinic in 2nd grade, set up his allowance/savings structure with the $100 bank-account milestone and August birthday match, and is his trusted source for everything from vaccines to theology questions.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Full sentences and proper punctuation, signs off with 'love you bud' or a heart emoji. Often asks open-ended questions ('what do you think?') instead of giving orders. Sends pickup-logistics texts and gentle reminders ('feed Biscuit?' / 'recycling tonight!').

shared_activities: After-school pickup from art club and soccer practice
Sunday allowance handoff and chore review
Doctor/pediatrician appointments with Dr. Nguyen
Co-reading the Amulet series and bedtime check-ins
Polling-place tag-along trips and church on Sundays
recent_text_topics: Logistics around her new Saturday clinic shifts (~2x/month) — confirming whether dad or she is doing soccer drop-off that week.
Reminders about Wednesday recycling and feeding Biscuit before school, with a running joke about the sticky note on the fridge.
Encouragement texts before state tests this month — references the 4-count box breathing Ms. Reyes taught him.
Counting down to his August birthday and the savings-match for the $80 LEGO Bionicle (currently $47 in the jar).
Checking in on Grandpa Gatlin in Tyler — relaying that he ate well at Easter and is doing okay since the cardiac device was implanted.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q03 ('she asks me questions until I figure out what I actually want'), Q05 ('My mom is a nurse, she works at the clinic in Rockwall'), Q16/Q73 (Sunday allowance), Q18 ('mom got a new shift schedule at the clinic so now she does Saturdays sometimes'), Q42 ('My mom. She's a nurse so she knows'), Q45 ('I'll tell my mom and she'll talk it through with me'), Q61 ('My mom says she'll help me open a real savings account when I have $100').

social_circle.name: Jacob Mendez

demographics.occupation: Student — 4th grader at Royse City Elementary
demographics.location: Royse City, TX 75189 (four streets over from Thomas, in the same tree-named subdivision)

background.how_they_met: Met in Mrs. ___'s 1st-grade class at Royse City Elementary in fall 2022 and have been best friends ever since. Jacob's mom carpools both boys to Oakwood Rangers practices and games.
background.why_close: Shared digital-native interests (Minecraft, Roblox), constant proximity (four streets apart, same school, same soccer carpool), and reciprocal trust — Thomas's only debt experience was a $3 Slurpee loan from Jacob, and Jacob is the friend Thomas told about when he was nervous about the soccer-vs-art-club crossroads.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Short, lowercase, no punctuation. Heavy use of 'bro', 'lol', and Minecraft jargon ('nether', 'iron farm'). Sends a lot of voice notes from his mom's iPad/his Gabb watch. Pokes Thomas with memes and Minecraft screenshots.

shared_activities: Daily-ish Minecraft sessions on their private two-player server (castle and pretend mall)
Friday-after-school pizza hangs
Weekend bike rides around the neighborhood and tree-climbing 'club' in his backyard
Carpooling to Tuesday/Thursday soccer practice with Jacob's mom
Sleepovers (most recently a Saturday at Thomas's)
recent_text_topics: Coordinating Minecraft server times after homework — currently building a 'mob trap' wing on the castle.
Plans for Thomas to bike over solo (new since March 2026) — 'on my way' / 'leave the gate open'.
Trash-talking about who scored at last Saturday's game in Wylie and whether Coach Davis will start Jacob at center mid.
Hyping the LEGO Bionicle countdown — Jacob has been sending screenshots of the set on Amazon.
Trading Aphmau and ZHC YouTube clips, plus debating whether to start a shared sketchbook.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q07 ('My best friend is Jacob Mendez, he's been my friend since first grade. He lives like four streets over... We have a server with just us two and we built a whole castle and a pretend mall'), Q04 ('My friend Jacob said do soccer because then we'd be on the same team'), Q07 follow-up ('Saturdays usually. Sometimes Friday after school we get pizza together'), Q63 ('I borrowed three dollars from Jacob once for a Slurpee').

social_circle.name: Mike Gatlin

demographics.occupation: Owner-operator of Gatlin Construction (residential framing, roofing, remodels) — 1-2 employees
demographics.education: Some college / associate's level; learned trade on the job

background.how_they_met: Biological father; has lived with Thomas his entire life in the Pecan Drive house the family bought before Thomas was born.
background.why_close: Mike is the steady, direct-style parent — co-regulated Thomas during the overlapping stress of Grandpa's hospitalization and the science fair by sitting with him and validating his fear. Has stepped up as Saturday-soccer dad since Sarah's clinic schedule changed.

key_traits: warm but less talky than Sarah
personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Terse, sometimes one word. Occasional misspellings. Uses thumbs-up emoji a lot. Sends photos from job sites ('look at this beam'). Doesn't text often during the workday but is responsive evenings.

shared_activities: Saturday soccer games at Greenville/Wylie when Sarah is working the clinic
Weekday breakfasts — dad-made eggs
Family football nights cheering for the Cowboys
Occasional dentist appointments (dad handles those)
Family Sundays at First Baptist and Grandma Joan's
recent_text_topics: Saturday game logistics on the Saturdays Sarah works — 'leaving in 10' / 'where's your kit'.
Thomas reminding dad to bring orange slices (running joke that dad's snack packing is worse than mom's).
Father-son plans to drive out to Tyler in June to visit Grandma & Grandpa Gatlin now that Grandpa is stable.
Random Cowboys offseason news Mike forwards from his Fox News feed.
Thomas asking dad about taking him to the Home Depot LEGO/build-a-thing weekend event.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q03 follow-up ('Dad just tells me what he thinks, which is sometimes faster but kinda less fun'), Q15 ('eat cereal or sometimes eggs my dad makes'), Q18 ('now she does Saturdays sometimes which means dad takes me to the soccer game'), Q44 ('my dad came and we just sat for a while and he said it's okay to be scared'), Q106-Q107 (Gatlin Construction details), seed (Dallas Cowboys family football nights).

social_circle.name: Joan Whitaker

demographics.education: High school diploma plus some community college

background.how_they_met: Sarah's mother; has been part of Thomas's life since birth. He sees her roughly every other weekend at her house in Greenville (~25 minutes away).
background.why_close: Grandma Joan is Thomas's secondary attachment figure — she bakes with him, lets him dig in her garden, watches old cartoons with him, and uses essential oils (lavender) on his headaches. She is the trusted overnight caregiver when Sarah and Mike travel. Thomas visits her on alternate weekends; she stays at the Gatlins' 3-4 times a year.

key_traits: slightly opinionated (gets corrected by Sarah on race comments)
personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts like an older adult — proper punctuation, sometimes types in all caps by accident, signs every text 'Love, Grandma'. Frequent photos of biscuits, garden veggies, and her cat. Occasional misuse of emoji (sends 🌹 for everything affectionate).

shared_activities: Baking cookies and (one famously burnt) pie at her house
Gardening and bug-hunting in her backyard
Old-cartoon afternoons while she does her crossword
Big Sunday lunches alternating between her house and the Gatlins'
Sleepovers at the Gatlins' when Sarah and Mike travel
recent_text_topics: Confirming this-weekend's visit and what cookie recipe to do (lemon shortbread is on rotation).
Grandma sending updates on Grandpa Gatlin's recovery and asking Thomas if he wants to FaceTime him.
Photos of Grandma's tomato seedlings and a question about whether Thomas wants a tray for his backyard.
Thomas asking Grandma to save the comics page from her Sunday paper for him.
Grandma's reminder that she's coming to his end-of-year art show and wants to know which piece is his.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 ('my Grandma Joan on my mom's side lives in Greenville which is closer. I see Grandma Joan a lot, like every other weekend usually. She makes really good biscuits... We bake stuff, like cookies and one time a pie that kinda burned. She has a garden and she lets me dig in the dirt'), Q11 ('Sometimes my Grandma Joan stays over for a weekend if my parents go away'), Q37 ('my Grandma Joan does essential oils and stuff and she rubs lavender on me sometimes when I have a headache'), Q30 follow-up (Sarah corrects Grandma on race comments).

interests: basketball at the Pecan Drive park

Oakwood Rangers practices (Tues/Thurs 5-6:30) and Saturday games
Pickup basketball at the park at the end of Pecan Drive
Sitting together in Mrs. Halverson's class for group projects
Occasional crossover playdates with Jacob
recent_text_topics: Rehashing weekend game results and arguing about who should play wing vs. center mid.
Plans for a 3-way Minecraft session with Jacob — Caleb is new to the server and needs spawn coords.
End-of-school-year stuff — who's in whose class next year and whether they'll both be on Rangers in the fall.
Caleb sending Roblox obby invites; Thomas saying he has to wait until homework is done.
Asking Thomas to draw him as a soccer-superhero character for his birthday card.
